sup.title: Inbox
sup.sub: Every customer message from every channel in one list: reply, write internal notes, take a conversation and mark it solved. Who answered is always kept.
sup.emptySub: Customers' messages arrive here once a channel is connected (WhatsApp, Messenger, the site's chat).
sup.noChannel: No channel is switched on yet, so no messages come in and replies cannot go out: they are kept in the conversation and marked "Not sent". Add your Facebook Page or WhatsApp number, or switch on the site chat, in Support settings.

th.notConnected: This channel is not connected yet: replies are kept here and marked "Not sent".

reason.CHANNEL_NOT_CONNECTED: the channel is not connected yet
reason.OUTSIDE_WINDOW: more than the reply window since the customer's last message
reason.FILES_NOT_SENT: files do not go out on this channel yet; send the words alone
reason.LIVE_CHAT_OFF: the site chat is switched off

compose.label: Write
compose.phNote: A note for the team: the customer never sees it…
compose.kept: Kept in the conversation; not sent: {reason}.
compose.readOnly: You can read this conversation but not reply.

log.d: Every message, reply, note, hand-over and change, with the name. Nothing here can be changed or removed.
log.IDENTITY_CUSTOMER: Linked to the customer with this number
log.PRODUCT_OPENED: The customer opened the product link
log.PRODUCT_ORDERED: Order {number} placed from the product link
log.ORDER_CREATED_ADVANCE: {name} created order {number}; it waits for its advance (pay link sent)
log.BLOCKED: {name} put this person on the support block list: {reason}
log.UNBLOCKED: {name} took this person off the support block list

err.EMPTY: Write something or add a file.
err.FILES_OFF: Files are switched off in Support settings.
err.TOO_MANY_FILES: Too many files for one message.
err.FILE_NOT_ALLOWED: This file cannot be added (its kind or size).
err.NOT_ASSIGNABLE: This person cannot take conversations here.
err.IDEMPOTENCY_MISMATCH: That press was already used; write it again.
err.FILE_PENDING: The file is still being copied; open it a little later.
err.NOT_FOUND: This conversation is not there any more.
err.INVALID_INPUT: Something in it is not right: {fields}
err.FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission for this.
err.forbidden: You do not have permission for this.
err.unauthorized: You have been signed out. Sign in again.
err.UNAUTHENTICATED: You have been signed out. Sign in again.
err.CALLBACK_OFF: “Call me” at checkout is switched off.
err.TOO_MANY: This number asked for a call-back too often today.
err.CONTACT_FORM_OFF: The contact page's form is switched off.
err.NOT_LINKED: There is nothing to undo here.
err.CATALOGUE_OFF: Products in the chat are switched off in Support settings.
err.OUT_OF_STOCK: This colour and size is sold out.
err.CART_OFF: Orders from the chat are switched off in Support settings.
err.NO_COD: Cash on Delivery is closed for this order and no advance is asked.
err.CHECKOUT: The order could not be made. Check again.
err.CHECKOUT_PRICE_CHANGED: The price or the stock changed. Check again, then press again.
err.CHECKOUT_OUT_OF_STOCK: A piece is sold out now. Take it out or change it.
err.CHECKOUT_NO_PAYMENT: No payment method is open for this order.
err.CHECKOUT_PAUSED: Ordering is paused while the ERP holds the account.
err.CHECKOUT_CART_NOT_OPEN: This bag already became an order. The page was read again.
err.CHECKOUT_IDEMPOTENCY: That press was already used. Press again.
err.FOLLOW_UP_OFF: Follow-ups are switched off in Support settings.
err.FOLLOW_UP_GONE: This follow-up was already sent, skipped or closed, or the customer wrote meanwhile; it was read again.
err.BLOCK_OFF: The support block list is switched off in Support settings.
err.BLOCKED: This person is on the support block list; no reply goes out.
err.PUSH_OFF: Notifications are switched off in Support settings.

set.title: Support settings
set.sub: Where messages come from, the site's chat, how the inbox works and files in a conversation.
set.readOnly: You can see these settings; changing them needs the "Change Support settings" permission.
set.pairHelp: Write it in both languages, or leave both empty.

inbox.d: How many conversations a page shows, how long a reply may be, and what a reply does.
inbox.assignOnReplyHelp: A reply to a conversation nobody has taken makes you its owner.
inbox.waitingOnReplyHelp: Your reply moves the conversation to "Waiting for customer" until the customer writes again.

set.phones: Customer numbers show masked here as everywhere in the admin (Customers settings); only people allowed a customer's full phone number see them whole.

attachments.d: Files the team may add to a reply or a note. Files a customer sends are always kept.

err.STALE: Someone changed this card in between; it was read again.
err.forbidden: You do not have permission for this.
err.unauthorized: You have been signed out. Sign in again.

channels.d: Where the inbox's messages come from. A Facebook Page or a WhatsApp number takes messages once it is added here and switched on, and its keys are in Keys & connections.
channels.empty: No channel yet. Add your Facebook Page or WhatsApp number below; the site chat appears here once it is switched on.
channels.chatOff: the chat button is off on the shop (Site chat card)
channels.addId: Page id or phone number id
channels.addIdHelp: Digits only, from the Meta app (the Page's id, or WhatsApp's phone number id). It comes in switched off.
channels.added: Added, switched off. Switch it on once its keys are in.

err.STALE: Someone changed this channel in between; the list was read again.
err.NOT_FOUND: This channel is not there any more.
err.forbidden: You do not have permission for this.
err.FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission for this.
err.unauthorized: You have been signed out. Sign in again.

liveChat.d: A chat button on the shop's pages. Visitors write; the team answers here in the inbox.
liveChat.enabledHelp: Off as it ships. Switched on, every shop page shows the button (on the other side from the WhatsApp disc).
liveChat.perMinute: Messages a visitor may send in a minute
liveChat.perMinuteHelp: Beyond this the chat asks him to wait a little (it stops floods).
liveChat.pollSeconds: How often an open chat looks for answers (seconds)
liveChat.cookieDays: How long a chat stays with a browser (days)
liveChat.cookieDaysHelp: The visitor sees his earlier messages on the same browser for this long.

window.d: Messenger and WhatsApp let a shop answer freely only for a while after the customer last wrote. Outside it a reply is kept and marked "Not sent".
window.replyWindowHoursHelp: Meta's rule is 24 hours. Raise it only if Meta has given your Page or number longer.

callMe.d: When a customer struggles at checkout, a small “Call me” offer appears. His tap lands here in the inbox as a call-back (channel “Call-back”), with his number. There is no permanent button.
callMe.enabledHelp: Off as it ships. Switched on, it shows only after the tries or the pause below.
callMe.failedTries: Refused tries on one box before it shows
callMe.idleSeconds: Seconds without progress before it shows
callMe.perPhonePerDay: Call-backs one number may leave a day
callMe.perPhonePerDayHelp: Stops one number filling the inbox.

identity.d: When a message arrives, the inbox finds the customer behind it: the number WhatsApp gives, or a Bangladeshi mobile number the customer types in the chat. The chat is linked to the customer with that number, and the same person's chats on other channels show together. Nothing is sent and no order changes.
identity.enabledHelp: Off as it ships. Works on messages that arrive after it is switched on.
identity.fromText: Take the number from the chat's words
identity.fromTextHelp: For Messenger and the site's chat, where the channel gives no number: the first mobile number the customer types (Bengali or English digits).
identity.autoLink: Put the same person's chats together
identity.autoLinkHelp: The same number or the same customer on another channel is one person. Two different customers are never put together.

context.d: On every chat, a card about the person writing: his orders in counts, how many were delivered, refused or returned, the risk score of his latest order, and the orders still on their way with where each one is now. Counts and the risk score show only to people who may read customers.
context.enabledHelp: On as it ships. Off: the chat only shows the customer's order count.
context.recentOrdersHelp: How many of his latest orders the card lists, besides those on their way (1–10).

catalogue.d: A "Products" button in the reply box (or "/" typed in an empty reply): search the shop's products by name, SKU or colour, pick the colour and size, and one press sends the photos, the name, the price and the product's link. The link carries this chat's own reference: when the customer opens it and orders, the order is credited to the chat and to the employee who sent it.
catalogue.enabledHelp: Off as it ships. The link opens the shop's own page at the shop's own price; nothing about the price or the order changes.
catalogue.photosHelp: 0–3. The chat's file rules still apply (files on, pictures allowed, the size limit).
catalogue.resultsHelp: How many products one search shows (4–20).
catalogue.creditDaysHelp: After the customer first opens the link, an order from that phone or computer within these days is credited to the chat (1–90).

cart.d: A "Chat bag" beside each conversation: products from the Products drawer at the shop's own prices and combos, then "Create order". The order keeps the chat's channel (WhatsApp, Messenger, Live chat). Your Parameter for Checkout is the fraud gate: when it asks this customer for an advance, no Cash on Delivery order is made — the order waits for the advance and its pay link goes into the chat.
cart.enabledHelp: Uses the Products drawer, so "Products in the chat" must be on too. Who may press Create order is the "Create an order from a chat" permission.
cart.wordsHelp: What the customer reads with the pay link. Use {number} for the order, {amount} for the advance and {link} for the link ({link} must be there). Never type an amount: it comes from your advance rule.

tickets.d: Each question from a customer becomes a ticket, from their message until you mark it solved: its owner is the person the chat is given to, with a timer for the first answer and one for the solution. The inbox shows each chat's timer and a "Late" view.
tickets.enabledHelp: A customer's message on a chat with no open ticket opens one. A ticket already open is kept up to date after you switch this off.
tickets.firstHelp: From the customer's message to the first reply. A note does not count.
tickets.resolutionHelp: From the customer's message until the chat is marked solved. While the chat waits for the customer the inbox shows no timer, but the time still counts.
tickets.notifyHelp: A late chat goes into its owner's notifications (the bell). A late chat nobody has taken goes to the people who may give chats out.

drafts.d: Above the reply box, a draft answer to what the customer asked last — cancel, a complaint, a late parcel, a bulk order, an exchange, a size or where the order is — from their words, the chat's order and its parcel, and Find My Size on the product last sent in the chat. A person presses "Use draft" and sends it; nothing goes out by itself.
drafts.enabledHelp: Shown only to people who may reply. A draft never promises a refund, a discount or an exchange.
drafts.banglishHelp: A message in Bengali letters is always answered in Bengali.
drafts.bulk: Pieces that make a bulk order
drafts.bulkHelp: "40 polos" with 10 here is a bulk order, marked for the owner when bulk is marked.

draftWords.d: The draft's words in English and Bengali. Use {hello} for the greeting, {name}, {number} (the order), {courier}, {tracking}, {size} and {days}. Never type an amount or a promise of money.

x.noOrder: No order found: ask for it

draftKeywords.h: Draft answers: the words that tell questions apart
draftKeywords.d: For each question, the words that tell it apart, separated by commas — Bengali, Banglish and English. A message is read in this order: cancel, complaint, late, bulk, exchange, size, where is my order, greeting.

followUp.h: Follow-ups on chats without an order
followUp.d: When a customer goes quiet after your answer and the chat did not become an order, a follow-up is put up for a person to send: the bag left in the chat, products sent and not ordered, or (win-back) an order that was cancelled. The "Follow-ups" view of the inbox lists them. Nothing goes out by itself.
followUp.enabledHelp: Shown only to people who may reply. A person reads it, may change the words, and presses Send or Skip.
followUp.afterHours: Hours the customer has been quiet
followUp.afterHoursHelp: Counted from the shop's last answer.
followUp.gapDaysHelp: One customer on every chat and channel counts once.
followUp.perDay: Follow-ups per day for the shop
followUp.windowMargin: Minutes left in the reply window
followUp.windowMarginHelp: Messenger and WhatsApp take a shop's answer only for a while after the customer's message. A chat with less time left gets none.
followUp.cancelledDays: Days a cancelled order counts for win-back
followUp.banglishHelp: A message in Bengali letters is always followed up in Bengali.
followUp.offerCodeHelp: Empty: no coupon. The code of a coupon you already made; it is mentioned only while that coupon is switched on, in its dates, open to every customer and not used up. The coupon is never changed here.

followUpWords.d: The words of each follow-up in English and Bengali. Only these may be used: {hello}, {name}, {product}, {code}.

privacy.d: Who sees which chats and numbers inside support.
privacy.ownChatsOnlyHelp: An employee who may not give chats out sees only the chats given to them and the ones nobody took.
privacy.maskNumbersInTextHelp: Phone numbers customers type are masked like the chat's own number for anyone not allowed the full number. The message itself is never changed.

blockList.d: Lets a person allowed to block (the owner, unless he gives it to a role) put a chat's person on the list with a reason. Nothing is deleted.
blockList.enabledHelp: Off: nobody counts as blocked (the list is kept). On: blocked people's chats move to the Blocked view, with no ticket, follow-up or reply.

app.d: Support on its own icon, like Messenger: it opens only support and can notify on the phone or computer. Each employee sets up their own device on Support → Support app.
app.enabledHelp: The support pages can be installed as an app (Android, iPhone, computer). Installed, it shows only support.
app.pushHelp: On the devices where an employee switched them on. Nothing leaves the server until the push key is in Keys & connections and its Test passed.

event.message: A customer writes (to the chat's owner, or everyone who may answer while nobody owns it)
event.assigned: A chat is given to someone

previewOpt.none: Only that there is a message
previewOpt.name: The customer's name
previewOpt.text: The name and the start of the message

app.ttlMinutes: Keep trying a phone that is off for (minutes)

person.d: This person's other chats, on other channels or earlier.
person.none: No other chat of this person.
person.fixed: Set by hand — the inbox will not change it.
person.phoneHelp: A Bangladeshi mobile number, Bengali or English digits. The customer with this number is linked.
person.badPhone: This is not a Bangladeshi mobile number.

ctx.byCustomer: Found from the chat's customer. Worked out again each time the chat opens.
ctx.byPhone: Found from the chat's number. Worked out again each time the chat opens.
ctx.unknown: Nobody known yet: no customer and no number on this chat. Set the number under "Same person".
ctx.none: No order for this customer or number yet.
ctx.noHistory: Counts and the risk score show only to people who may read customers.

prod.none: No product on sale matches these words.
prod.photos: Sends up to {n} photos, the name, the price and the link.

cart.d: This customer's order, at the shop's own prices, combos and offers.
cart.empty: The bag is empty. Add products with "Add to bag" in the Products drawer.
cart.name: Name
cart.advanceLine: The shop's rule asks {amount} ahead for this order, so it is not a Cash on Delivery order. Take advance makes the order, it waits for the advance, and the pay link goes into the chat.
cart.closed: Cash on Delivery is closed for this order and no advance is asked, so no order can be made here.
cart.addressAsk: The address names no place the shop knows: the order will be marked "address unclear" and the team will call.
cart.madeAdvance: Order {number} created. It waits for the advance; the pay link is in the chat.

problem.name: Write the customer's name.
problem.phone: The phone number is not a full mobile number.

tk.d: This question's timers. A new question after "Solved" is a new ticket.
tk.waiting: Waiting for the customer: no timer.

dr.note: Read it, change what you like, then send. Nothing goes out by itself.

fu.window: The channel takes an answer until {at}.
fu.offer: It mentions your coupon {code} (live). The coupon itself is not changed.
fu.label: Words (change them as you like)
fu.skipped: Skipped. It comes back only if the chat moves.

block.reasonHelp: Their messages are kept and move to the Blocked view: no ticket, no follow-up, no reply. Every channel of this person counts. You can take them off again.
block.blocked: Blocked. The chat moved to the Blocked view.
block.note: This person is on the support block list since {at}: {reason}. Their messages are kept; no reply goes out.

app.title: Support app
app.sub: Install support on this phone or computer and get notified about new chats.
app.off: The support app is switched off in Support settings.

install.d: Put support on its own icon. Installed, it opens only support.
install.ios: On iPhone or iPad: open this page in Safari, tap Share, then “Add to Home Screen”.
install.other: In your browser's menu choose “Install app” or “Add to Home screen”.
install.standalone: You are in the support app.

notify.d: New messages and chats given to you, even when the app is closed.
notify.pushOff: Notifications are switched off in Support settings.
notify.practice: Practice mode: the push key is not in Keys & connections yet, so nothing reaches a phone. The owner adds it there.
notify.testedPractice: Practice mode: the test was kept on the server, not sent.
notify.denied: Notifications are blocked for this site in the browser's settings. Allow them there, then try again.
notify.unsupported: This browser cannot get notifications. On iPhone, install the app first (Add to Home Screen), then open it from its icon.

devices.none: No device has notifications on yet.

offline.title: No internet
offline.body: Support opens again when the connection is back.

push.assigned: A chat on {channel} was given to you

err.PUSH_OFF: Notifications are switched off in Support settings.
err.INVALID_INPUT: This device gave something the shop cannot use.

an.title: Support analytics
an.sub: How fast the team answers and how many chats become orders — per channel and per person.

period.label: Period
period.bad: That period could not be shown (the end before the start, or longer than {n} days). Showing the last {d} days.

an.own: You see your own figures. People who give chats out see the whole team and every channel.

how.chats: Chats: for a channel, chats where a customer wrote in the period; for a person, chats they answered.
how.first: First answer and Solved in: from the customer's question (a ticket) to the first answer, and to “Solved”. The middle shows the usual time; one very slow chat does not hide it.
how.late: Late: answered or solved after the timer in Support settings (Tickets and timers), or still waiting past it.
how.orders: Chat → order: chats with an order made in the chat or from a product link sent in it. An order is credited to the person who made it or sent the link.
how.sales: Sales: only orders delivered. An order placed but not delivered yet is in Orders, not in Sales.

err.INVALID_INPUT: That period could not be shown.
